terms.gloss: sort out, settle, straighten out (a business, a matter)
evidence: Cic. Fam. 13.26.2: petō ā tē, ut ejus negōtia explicēs et expediās (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Literally “unfold, disentangle”: the same verb as “explain”, here with a matter or business as its object.

terms.gloss: settle, get clear, put in order

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 108.
